title: A Kinetic Energy Preserving and Entropy Conserving Two-Point Flux for Multi-species Compressible Flow
summary: High-order entropy stable (ES) methods have attracted much interest in the computational fluid dynamics (CFD) research community over the past decade, as we seek to simulate practical engineering applications with high accuracy and robustness. As industry delves further into supersonic flight and space travel, we need schemes capable of modelling flows with multiple chemical species that interact and mix within the fluid.
